messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm prototyping an "effective_token_cost" metric for the cost dashboard to show token cost after cache savings and routing demuxing. putting up a tiny mock.
ali: nice. is this per-invocation or aggregated per-model+route?
jordan: per-model+route sounds right — teams care about model variant economics. per-invocation we can show in detail view.
maria: yep. top-level card: model, route, avg_raw_token_cost, cache_offset_pct, effective_token_cost. drilldown = histogram of per-invocation effective cost.
sasha: how do you plan to allocate cache savings? we still have sticky-routing and shared-prefetch which complicate attribution.
maria: thinking of two fields: "prefetch_credit_apportioned" (heuristic: proportional to prefix-hit probability) and "hotpath_direct_savings" (direct hits). both will feed into cache_offset_pct.
kevin: watch sampling. our current telemetry samples 1/100 for token-level shapes. if we roll naive aggregation we bias effective cost low for heavy cached routes.
jordan: good flag. we probably need an adjusted estimator with importance weights. simple SQL sketch I used:
```
SELECT model_variant, route, SUM(weighted_tokens * unit_cost) / SUM(weight) AS effective_token_cost
FROM token_telemetry_samples
-- weight = 1 / sample_rate * cache_credit_multiplier
GROUP BY 1,2;
```
maria: exact — weight = (1 / sample_rate) * (1 - cache_hit_rate + apportioned_prefetch_credit) so cached invocations still contribute.
ali: does this require changing our ingestion schema? where do we get apportioned_prefetch_credit?
sasha: we already emit prefetch_lineage events with a prefetch_credit field, but it's coarse. might need a join between invocation id -> prefetch lineage which is currently sampled independently. joins across samples are messy.
kevin: ops risk: doing joins at query time will blow up cost. prefer emitting a unified precomputed sample record in the batcher where we already have both invocation and prefetch context. small instrument change but simpler downstream.
maria: agreed. I'll add a tiny telemetry PR to the batcher to emit sample_record with fields: sample_rate, cache_hit (bool), prefetch_credit_estimate, token_count, model_variant, route. low churn.
jordan: UX: where do we show uncertainty? folks will take single number as gospel. we should show a confidence band or sample_count badge.
ali: +1 — show (n sampled / est n) and a small tooltip: "est. std err from sampling".
sasha: rollout plan? internal flag first, then console opt-in for teams. also need a canary for billing previews so customers don't see sudden changes in invoice preview for small sampling shifts.
maria: plan: internal flag -> 48hr validation on production sampled bucket -> console opt-in (beta) -> stable. will post PR links.
kevin: also add an alert if sample_count < threshold for a model+route (say 50) and warn on UI.
costbot: deploy-bot: telemetry PR 1294 merged to staging at 1789990035 :thumbsup:
maria: thanks all — I'll open the telemetry PR and a tiny dashboard mock. ping me if you want to review the estimator math.
ali: happy to review. quick nit: call the UI field "effective token cost (post-cache)" so product folks understand.
jordan: love it. end-to-end looks solid.
__note: This document represents a Slack thread. Messages are chronological and prefixed with sender name.
